text: Patapita zaka zinayi patent idaperekedwa, imene idali patent yoyamba padziko lapansi kupekedwa yokhudza MRI.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Mu chaka 1997, Dr. Damadian anamaliza kumanga chomwe amati ndi “thupi lonse” pa MRI scanner, imene adayitchula “Indomitable”.
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Kuyakhula motsindika kumathandiza kupeleka nthawi yachikumbu mtima ndikuti ena achitepo kanthu.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Amalola ophunzira kuti azitha kugwira ntchito momwe angafunire komanso kuongolera kayendetsedwe ka zidziwitso za ma maphunzilo monga iwo afunira.
eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Kuonjezerapo, pali nthawi zoletsa zochepa ndizokuthekera kosintha maola ogwirira ntchito (Bremer, 1998).
eng_text: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Kugwilitsa ntchito intaneti ndi matsamba a intaneti zimathandiza awo akupanga sukulu kuti azikhala ndimwayi wodziwa zambiri nthawi iliyonse.
eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Ophunzira athanso kupereka mafunso kwa mphunzitsi nthawi ina iliyonse ya patsiku ndipo ayembekezere kulandira mayankho mwachangu, kusiyana ndikuti azidikira kuti akomaneso maso ndi maso.
eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Njira zomwe akugwilitsa ntchito makono zimapereka ufulu ndithu. Palibenso njira ina yabwino yophunzirapo.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Mwatchutchu, palibe chabwino choti muphunzire. Kuphunzira kumatenga malo pakati pa ophunzira ndiponso pakupereka zomwe waphunzirazo.
eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Zimene taziziwa zonse zokhuzana ndi njira yoti uzipanga wekha ndikuwonetsa zambiri, ziwonetsero za pakanema ophunzilira zikusonyeza mfundo imeneyi.
eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Ambiri a ife timapezeka tikuwonera wayilesi ya kanema imene imatidziwitsa njira zina koma zomwe sititenga nawo mbali kapena kugwiritsa ntchito zomwe tadziwazo.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Sitingamasule galimoto, kumanga fountain kumpanda, kuyenda kupita ku Peru kukaona nyumba zakale kapena kukonza nyumba ya omwe tawandikana nawo.
eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Ndayamika chingwe cha optic fiber cholowera pansi pa nyanja cholumikiza ku Ulaya ndi satellite, Greeland ndiyolumikizana bwino ndi 93% ya anthu omwe ali ndi intaneti.
eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Malo ogona omwe muli kapena eni malo mukugona (ngati mukukhala mnyumba ya alendo kapena nyumba yaeni) atha kukhala ndi wifi kapena intaneti yolumikizidwa ku PC, ndipo midzi yonse ili malo amalonda wopangirako intaneti kapena malo ena a wifi ya aliyense.
eng_text: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Monga tanenela pamwambapa ngakhale kuti mau oti “Esikimo” ali ovomelezedwa ku America anthu ambiri akwina monga Arctic makamaka ku dziko la Canada amawatenga kuti mauwa ndi onyogodola.
eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Pamene mukumva mawuwa akugwiritsidwa ntchito ndi mbadwa zaku Greenland, magwiritsidwe ake a ntchito ayenera kupewedwa ndi anthu ochokera kunja kwadzikolo.
eng_text: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Mbadwa zochokera ku Greenland zimadzitchula kuti ndima Inuit pamene aliku Canada ndiponso Kalaalleq (kuchuluka Kalaallit), ma Greenlander, ku Greenland.
eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Upandu ndi nkhanza , kwa obwera sizidziwika ku Greenland.Ngakhale mtawuni mulibe malo ovuta.
eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Nyengo yozizira ndiye chiopsezo chenicheni chomwe chimapeza osakonzekera.
eng_text: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Ngati mukupita ku Greenland nthawi yozizira (poganizira kuti pamene ukupita kumpoto kwambiri mpamene kumazizira kwambiri), ndikoyenera kutenga zovala zotenthera zokwanira.
eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Masiku ataliatali nthawi yotentha amapangitsa kubweletsa mavuto ovutika kugona ndikubweletsa zina zovuta pamoyo wamunthu.
eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Munyengo yotentha khalani tcheru ndi udzudzu waku Nordic. Ngakhale suyambitsa matenda, koma umasowetsa mtendere.
eng_text: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Pamene nkhani zachuma zaku San Francisco zikulumikizana ndi kukopa alendo kochititsa chidwi padziko lonse lapansi, chuma chake chimachokera m'magawo osiyanasiyana.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Anthu ambiri wogwira ntchito ndi amene ali akadaulo, aboma, zandalama, malonda ndi zokopa alendo.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Mukuonetsedwa mwawo makamaka munyimbo, makanema, zolemba komanso chikhalidwe zodziwika zathandiza kupanga mzindawu ndiponso zochitika zake kudziwika padziko lonse.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco yamanga malo akuluakulu okopa alendo omwe ali malo ogona ambiri, malo odyera ambiri komaso malo ena apamwamba.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco ndi malo amodzi amalo omwe ali abwino mdziko pa nkhani ya zakudya zina zaku Asia: zaku Korea, zaku Thailand, zaku India komaso zaku Japan.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Kupita ku Walt Disney World zimaonetsa kuti ulendo wofunikira kwambiri kwa mabanja ambiri ku America.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Ulendo “wamba” umakhudza kukwera ndege kupita kubwalo lalikulu la ndege la Orlando International, ndikukwera basi pamalo owogona a Disney, mkukhalako pafupifupi sabata imodzi osasiya katundu wa Disney, ndikubwelera kwawo.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Pali kuthekera kosiyana ndithu kosatha, koma izi ndi zokhazikika zomwe anthu ambiri amatanthauza akamanena zokhudza “kupita ku Disney World”.
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Matikiti ambiri omwe amagulitsidwa pa matsamba a intaneti monga eBay kapena Craigslist amakhala kuti ndi matikiti oti mutha kugwiritsa ntchito kumalo ambiri komaso amakhala agwirapo ntchito kale pang'ono.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Ngakhale izi zimachitikachitika zimaletsedwa ndi a Disney: ndipo matiketi sapatsidwa kwa wina.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Kumanga masasa pansi kunja kwa Grand Canyon kumafunika chilolezo choti muzabwelera ku dziko lanu.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Zilolezo sizimaperekedwa zambiri zokhuza kuteteza canyon, choncho zimapezeka tsiku loyamba la mwezi, miyezi inayi usanayambe mwezi woyambirawo.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Chifukwa, chilolezo chobwelera chimayamba tsiku loyamba mu Meyi.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Malo ku malo otchuka kwambiri monga Bright Angle Campground moyandikana ndi Phanto Ranch kumadzadza tsiku lomwelo loyamba kuti anthu asungitse malo.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Pamakhala zilolezo zochepa zomwe zimasungiridwa kwa ongobwera kudzafunsa potengera kuti woyamba kufika, ndi amene amayambirira kuthandizidwa.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Kulowa Kumwera kwa Africa pa galimoto ndi njira yabwino yoonera kukongora kwa derali komanso kufikila malo amene samatchulidwa njira zodutsa alendo.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Izi zitha kuchitika mgalimoto zathu zamasiku onse ngati pali dongosolo labwino ngakhale ma 4x4 ndi amene aliwoyenera ndipo malo ambiri amafikidwa ndimagalimoto am'mwamba a 4X4 basi.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Dzindikirani kuti pomwe mukukonzekera kuti kumwera kwa Africa ndikwabata koma osati mayiko onse oyandikana ali pamtendere.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Zofunikira pa Visa pamodzi ndi mitengo yake zimakhala zosiyanasiyana kutengera dziko lomwe ukuchokera.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Dziko lilonse lili ndimalamulo ake azinthu zomwe zimafunikira galimoto itapanga ngozi.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls ndi kamzinda kakang'ono kakumadzulo kwa dziko la Zimbabwe, kudutsa ku malire kuchokera ku Livingstone, Zambia, ndiponso kufupi ndi dziko la Botswana.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Mzindawu uli pafupi ndi mathithi, ndipo ndi amene amakopa kwambiri, ndipo malo osililikawa amapatsa onse okonda zochitika ndi ofuna kukawona malo mwayi wawukulu wokhala nthawi yayitali.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Munyengo ya mvula (Novembala mpaka Marichi), kuchuluka kwa madzi kumakhala kokwera ndi Mathithi amakhala wosangalatsa.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Nzodziwikilatu kuti munyowa ngati muyenda njira yooloka mulatho kapena tinjira tam'mbali mwa mathithi.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Pena, nchifukwa chakuti madziwo ndi ambiri moti simudzatha kuona mathithio bwino- chifukwa cha kuchuluka madzi.
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Manda a Tutankhamun (KV62).KV62 akhoza kukhala manda odziwika m'chigwa, pomwe Howard Carter mu 1922 anatulukira kuti anali manda pafupifupi osawonongeka a mfumu yaying'ono.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Kufanizira ndi manda ena achifumu, ngakhale zili choncho manda a Tutankhamun ndiwoyenerabe kumawayendera, pakuti ndi wochepa ndiponso sanawakongoletsedwe kwambiri.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Aliyense wofuna umboni wa kuonongeka kwa ntembo pamene amafunira kuuchotsa mu bokosi azakhumudwa poti mutu ndi khosi ndi zomwe zili zoonekela.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Chuma chambiri cha m'manda sichilinso m'mandamo, koma chinachotsedwa kupita ku Egyptian Museum ku Cairo.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Alendo amene alibe nthawi yambiri nkwabwino kuti akataye nthawiyo ku malo ena.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, makilomita khumi ndi awiri kumwela kwa chaku madzulo kwa Siem Reap. Kachisi wapa phiri ili anamangidwa pokutha pa zaka za ma 800 panthawi ya ulamuliro wa mfumu Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Maonekedwe a mdima amukachisi ndi mawonekedwe a nyanja yotchedwa Tonle Sap amapangitsa kukwela phiri kukhala koyenela.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Ulendo wokaona kumaloko utha kuphatikizidwa ndi ndi ulendo wapa ngalawa wopita ku nyanja.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Angkor Pass imafunika kuti ulowe mu kachisi choncho musayiwale kubweletsa ziphaso zanu zolowela ndi kutulukila m'dziko mukamapita ku Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Yerusalemu ndi likulu komaso mzinda waukulu wa dziko la Israel ngakhale mayiko ambiri kuphatikizapo United Nations sivomereza kuti mzindawu ndi likulu la dzikolo.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Mzinda wakale mumapiri a Yudea uli ndi mbiri yochititsa kaso ya zaka zikwizikwi zochulukirapo.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Mzinda umenewu ndiwoyera kuzipembedzo zitatu zokhudza Mulungu m'modzi - Chiyuda, Chikhristu ndi Chisilamu, komanso umagwiritsidwa nchito ngati malo auzimu, chipembedzo, ndiponso ngati chikhalidwe.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Chifukwa cha kufunika kwachipembedzo kwa mzindawu, makamaka malo ambiri ndiamumzinda wakalekale, Yerusalemu ndi amodzi amalo omwe kumapitako alendo ambiri mdziko la Israeli.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Yerusalemu ili ndi malo odziwika ndi ofunika ambiri, azinthu zakale komanso malo achikhalidwe, pamodzi ndi malo okongola ndi owunjikana anthu ogulitsirako, khofi komanso malo odyerako.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ecuador imafuna kuti nzika zaku Cuba zizikhala ndi kalata zosonyeza kuti zayitanidwa kuti zilowe mdzikolo zisanalowe mu Ecuador podzera m'mabwalo andege akuluakulu kapena malo am'malire adzikolo.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Kalatayi ikuyenera kuvomelezedwa ndi malamulo ndi Unduna wa Zakunja ku Ecuador, komanso kukwaniritsa zina zofunifira.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Zofunikirazi zidakhazikitsidwa kamba kofuna kuti mayendedwe olowa ndi kutuluka mdziko akhale olongosoka pakati pa mayiko awiri.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Nzika zaku Cuba zomwe zili ndi makadi a green card aku US ayenera kufika ku ofesi ya oyimilira kazembe waku Ecuador kuti akatenge chilolezo choti zimenezi iwo zisawakhuze.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Chiphaso chanu cha ulendo chikuyenera kukhala chovomerezeka kwa miyezi isanu ndi umodzi kupitilira masiku anu aulendo. Tiketi yanu kaya yobwelera/ yopitilira imafunika kutsikimizira kutalika kwa nthawi yomwe mukhale.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Maulendo ndiotsika mtengo m'magulu akulu, chifukwa chake ngati muli nokha kapena ndi nzanu m'modzi, yesani kukumana ndi anthu ena ndikupanga gulu la anayi mpaka asanu kuti mulandire mtengo wabwino.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Choncho, zimenezi siziyenera kukupatsani nkhawa, chifukwa kawirikawiri alendo amapachiridwa ndicholinga choti adzaze m'magalimoto.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Ndi njira chabe yowapusitsa anthu kuti mwina adziwapatsa ndalama yambiri.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Kudutsa pamwamba pa kumpota kwa Machu Picchu ndi phiri lalitali, limakhala chithunzi chamabwinja ambiri a zinthu zakale.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Zikuoneka kuti ndizovutilako kuchokera pansi, ndi mtsetse wovuta kukwera, koma anthu omwe matupi awo ali amphamvu amatha kukwera potenga mphindi 45.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Masitepe amiyalaya adaikidwa munjira zambiri, malo wotsetsereka kwambiri muli zingwe zazitsulo zomwe anthu amazigwira pothandizira kupereka mphamvu zoti asagwe.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Zili choncho, yembekezerani kuti mubanika, ndipo samalani magawo otsetseleka makamaka kukanyowa poti kumakhala koopsya.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Pafupi ndi pamwamba pali kaphanga kamene kayenera kudutsidwa, kali m'musi kwambiri, ndipo ndikothina ndithu.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Kuwona malo ndi nyama zamtchire zaku Galapagos zimafunika kugwilitsa ntchito ngalawa ngati m'mene adapangira Charles Darwin mu chaka cha 1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Sitima zam'madzi zopitilira 60 zimadutsa m'madzi a Galapagos-Zonyamula anthu 8 kulekeza 100.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Anthu ambiri amasungitsa malo awo lisanafike tsiku la ulendo (pachifukwa chakuti maboti amakhala odzaza nthawi yokondedwa yayitali).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Onetsetsani kuti mkhala pakati amene adakuthandizani akhale katswiri wapa Galapagos ndiwodziwa bwino mitundu yochuluka ya sitima zam'madzi.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Zimenezi zizawonetsa makamaka zofuna zanu ndi/kapena zosowa zanu zagwirizana ndi sitima yoyenera bwino kwa iwo.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Nthawi imene anthu aku Spain asadafike muzaka zamazana 16, kumpoto kwa Chile amalamuliridwa ndi Inca pamene nkhalakale zachi Araucania (Mapuche) amakhala pakati komanso kumwera kwa Chile.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: A Mapuche anali gulu limodzi loyima palokha lakumudzi ku America omwe sadatengereko zoyankhula zaku Spain ndi ulamuliro mpakana Chile atayamba kudzilamulira.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Ngakhale dziko la Chile linalengeza za ufulu wodziyimilira mu 1810 (mkatikati mwa nkhondo ya Napoleon imene inasiya dziko la Spain kukhala ndi boma losagwira ntchito kwa zaka zambiri), kupambana kwakukulu ku dziko la Spain sikunakwaniritsidwe mpaka mu 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Dominican Republic (Spanish: Rupública Dominicana) ndi dziko la Caribbean limene linatenga theka la malo a chigawo chakumanja a chilumba cha Hispaniola, chimene imagawana ndi Haiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Kupatula magombe a mchenga oyela ndi mapiri, dzikoli lili ndi mzinda wakale kwambiri wa anthu a ku Ulaya kumwela kwa America, kumene pano ndi mbali ya Santo Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Chilumbachi chidayamba kukhalidwamo ndi anthu achi Taínos komanso ma Caribes. Ma Caribes ankalankhula Arawakan ndipo adafika pafupifupi 10,000 BCE.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: M'zaka zochepa kuchokera pamene ofufuza aku Ulaya anafika, anthu a ku Tainos anali atachepepa kwambiri chifukwa cha kugonja ndi Spain.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Malingana ndi a Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) pakati pazaka zam'ma 1492 komanso 1498 asilikali wochokera ku Spain adapha ma Taíno ngati 100,000.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Malo amenewa adamangidwa ngati atrium ya nyumba ya zaka mazana 17, Templo de Sa Diego ndi nyumba yokhayo imene idatsala.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Ili ngati malo apakati , ndipo zinthu zambiri zimachitika , m'mawa ndi madzulo.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Pali malo ambiri odyera ozungulira mundawo, madzulo komaso usiku pamakhala zoyimbayimba zaulere zomwe zimachitikira pakati pa gazebo.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the kiss). Makonde awili omwe anasiyana ndi ma sentimita 69 ndi malo akalekale achikondi.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Ndi ndalama yochepa kwambiri ana ena atha kukuwuzani nkhani.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Chilumba cha Bowen ndi chodziwika ndi ulendo wapatsiku kapena mathelo asabata, kumene kumapezeka kayaking, kuyenda, masitolo, malo odyera, ndi zina.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Malo ovomerezekawa ali ku Howe Sound kungodutsa Vancouver, amapezeka mosavuta kudzera pama taxi m'madzi ochokera ku Chilumba cha Granville kumusi kwa Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Kwa amene amakonda zochitika panja , ulendo wochoka ku Sea to Sky ndi ofunika.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (komwe ndikoyenda maola 1.5 kuchokera ku Vancouver), ndikodula zinthu koma ndi kodziwika chifukwa chamasewelo a 2010 Winter Olympic.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Munyengo yozizila pitani mukasangalale ndi masewela a skiing kumpoto kwa America mu chilimwe pitani mukakwele njinga m'mapiri.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Muyenera kusungitsiratu Zilolezo. Muyenera kukhala ndichilolezo kuti mugone ku Sirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ndimalo okhawo a alenje kumene alendo amagona ngati gulu, kumapezeka chakudya chotentha kuphatikizapo misasa. Pamene La Leona, San Pedrillo, ndi Los Patos amapereka misasa yokha basi popanda chakudya.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Ku Ranger Station imene ili ku Puerto Jiménez, kumeneku mutha kukapeza ziphaso zolowera ku paki , choncho samalora kulipira ndi makadi a credit card.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: A Park Service (MINAE) samaperekeratu zilolezo za paki kupitilira mwezi umodzi omwe mukuganiza kufika.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol imapanga zosungitsa malo pamtengo wa $30, komanso $10 kwa tsiku limodzi; zambiri zili pa tsamba la Corcovado.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Dziko la Cook ndi la zilumba limene limagwirizana mopanda kukamizidwa ndi dziko la New Zealand, lomwe lili ku Polynesia, pakati pa Nyanja yamchere ya Pacific.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Ndi gulu la zilumba zokwana 15 zofalikira mtunda wautali okwana mamaliyoni 2.2 km2 pa nyanja.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Kamba kakuti ali mu gawo lanthawi yofanana ngati yaku Hawaii, zilumbazi nthawi zina zimaonedwa ngati “Hawaii wapansi”.
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Ngakhale ndizocheperako, zimakumbutsa alendo ena okalamba omwe adafika ku Hawaii lisadakhazikitsidwe boma opanda malo ogonamo akulu onse akulu ndi zitukuko zina.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Chilumba Cha Cook chilibe mizinda yiliyonse koma chili ndi zilumba 15 zosiyanasiyana. Zomwe zikululuzikulu ndi Rarotonga ndi Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: M'mayiko otukuka masiku ano, kupereka makama otchedwa deluxe ndi kadzutsa zafika ngati paluso tsopano.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Pamwamba pomalizirapo, B&Bs chachidziwikire imapikisana kwambiri pa zinthu ziwiri: Zofunda ndi Kadzutsa.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Choncho, m'malo abwino ngati awa mutha kupeza zofunda zabwino kwambiri , mwina chopangidwa ndi manja kapena kama lamasiku adzana.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Chakudya cham'mawa chitha kukhala zakudya zomwe zimabwera mu nyengo zina za mchigawocho kapena chakudya chapaderadera chomwe wakonza mwini nyumba.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Malowa atha kukhala a nyumba ya mbiri yakale yokhala ndi ziwiya zakale ma bwalo otchetchedwa bwino komanso dziwe losambira.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Kukwera mugalimoto yako ndikuyenda ulendo wautali ndizinthu zina zake zosangalatsa.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Mosayelekeza ndi magalimoto akuluakulu, nkutheka kuti mukudziwa bwino lomwe kuyendetsa galimoto yanu komanso mukudziwa zofooka zake.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Kukhoma chihema pamalo anu kapena mumzinda waung'ono uliwonse kungathe kubweletsa chidwi chosafunikira.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Mwachindunji, kuyenda pa galimoto yanu ndi njira yabwino yoyendera koma sinjira imene imagwiritsidwa nthawi zambiri popita ku “msasa”.
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Kukhala mugalimoto ndikotheka ngati muli ndi galimoto lokulirapo la minivan, SUV, Sedan kapena Station Wagon ndi mipando yoti itha kugonekedwa.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Malo ena ogona alendo ali ndi mbiri yochokera kunthawi ya golden age yamasitima apamtunda woyendera nthuzi komanso masitima am'madzi akuluakulu otenga anthu; nkhondo yachiwiri isadayambe, mzaka za m'mazana khumi ndi zisanu mchinayi kapena kumayambiliro azaka zam'mazana makumi awiri.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Malo ogonawa kunali kumene anthu olemela ndi otchuka amasiku amenewo amakhala , ndiponso nthawi zambiri amakhala ndi malo abwino odyela komanso chisangalalo chabwino cha usiku.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Zovala zachikale, kusowa kwa zinthu zamakonoi, komanso chikale china chokongola ndichimodzi mwazikhalidwe zawo.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Ngakhale kuti malowa siofikila alendo, nthawi zina atsogoleri a maiko ndi olemekezeka ena amalandilidwa.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Wapaulendo amene ali ndi ndalama zambiri atha kuganiza zozungulira dziko lonse pandege, powugawa pomakhala m'malo ogona ambiriwa.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Kulandila alendo mwamsangala komanso kusithana mauthenga ndi bungwe limene limalumikiza anthu apaulendo ndi anthu akumizinda kumene akupita.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Kulowa pa netiweki imeneyi kumafunika kulemba fomu yapa intanenti, ngakhale ma netiweki ena amafuna kutsimikiza kowonjezerapo.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Mndandanda wa eni malo omwe alipo udaperekedwa podzera pakutsindikizidwa ndi/ kapena pa intaneti, nthawi zina ndi umboni ndi kuwunikira kwa apaulendo ena.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing idayamba mu Januwale chaka 2004 kamba kakatswiri olemba mapulogalamu apakompuyuta a Casey Fenton adapeza ndege yotsika mtengo yopita ku Iceland koma adalibe malo oti akhaleko kumeneko.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Anatumiza imelo kwa ophunzira ku yunivesite yakomweko ndipo analandira mwayi wochuluka wopatsidwa mwaulere malo ogona.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Malo okhala gulu amasunga achinyamata - alendo ambili amakhala ndi zaka zam'ma kumi awiri- koma mutha kupeza akuluakulunso kumeneku nthawi zina.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Ndizosowa kuti uwone mabanja omwe ali ndi ana, koma malo ogona chigulu amalola kuti akhale muzipinda zawozawo.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Mzinda wa Beijin ku China ndiwomwe masewera adzachitikire amu nyengo yozizira a Olympic Winter Games mu 2022, zomwe zizapangitse kuti ukhale mzinda woyamba kuchitika masewerowa kawiri amunyengo yotentha komaso yozizira.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Ku Beijin ndikomwe kukachitikire mwambo wa zotsegulira ndi zotsekera zamasewera komaso masewero anyumba apadzi owuma.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Zochitika zina zokhuza masewero a skii, zikachitikira ku malo a Taizicheng ski amene ali mu mzinda wa Zhangjiakou, pafupifupi makilomita 220 (mamayilosi 140) kuchokera ku Beijing.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Zikondwelero zapachaka zamakachisi ambiri zimayamba kumapeto kwa Novembala mpaka pakati pa Meyi, ndipo zimasiyanasiyana malingana ndi kalendala yapachaka ya kachisi.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Zikondwelero zokhudza mu kachisi zimakhala gawo lokondwelera chaka kapena kubadwa kwa timilungu kapena zikondwelero zina zokhudza tchalitchi.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Maphwando amu kachisi wa Kerala ndiwopatsa chidwi kuonera, ndi mayendedwe anthawi zonse a njovu zokongoletsedwa, mayimbidwe amukachisi ndi zikondwelero zina.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Chiwonetsero cha Padziko lonse (chotchedwa World Exposion, kapena kuti Expo) ndichikondwerero chachikulu chamayiko ambiri omwe amawonetsa zalunso ndi sayansi.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Mayiko amene akutenga nawo mbali amaonetsa luso ndi zamaphunziro mu dziko lawo kapena kuwonetsa zinthu zokhudza dziko ndi mbiri yamayiko yawo.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: International Horticultural Expositions ndi zochitika zapadera zomwe zimawonetsa maluwa, minda yamaluwa ndi china chilichonse chokhudzana ndi zomera.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Ngakhale kuti nkulingalira nkotheka kupangika chaka ndi chaka (bola zichitike maiko osiyanasiyana), koma sizingatheke kutero.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Zochitika izi zimakhalapo kulikonse pakati miyezi yitatu ndi isanu ndi umodzi ndipo zimachitima m'malo osachepera mahekita 50.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Ilipo mitundu yochuluka yamakanema imene yagwiritsidwa ntchito kwa zaka zochuluka. Kanema wa Standard wa 35 mm (36 ndi 24 mm negative) ndi amene amapezeka ponseponse.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Zimatheka kubwenzeletsedwa mosavuta zikati zatha, koma kutapezeka njira yakuti pamenepo ndiyabwinoko ya DSLR.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Makamela ena a pakatipati amakanema amagwilitsa ntchito filimu ya masentimita 6 ndi 6, ambiri kwenikweni ama negative okula mamilimita 56 ndi 56.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Izi zimapereka mawalidwe pafupifupi kanayi kama 35 mm negative (3136mm2 versus 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Nyama zakuthengo ndizovuta zina kwa amene amajambula zithunzi, choncho kumafunikira mwayi, kupilira, kudziwa bwino komanso zida zoyenera.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Zithunzi zachilengedwe zakutchire sizimatengedwa ngati zofunikira nthawi zambiri, koma m'mene zojambula zilili, chithunzi ndicholemera mawu zikwi.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Kujambula zithunzi za chilengedwe mthengo kunali makamera ama lens ataliatali ngakhale kuti zinthu ngati mbalame ndi zolengedwa zina zing'onozingono zimafuna ma lens amitundu ina.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Nyama zambili zobwela nzovuta kuzipeza ndipo nthawi zina nkhalango zosungilako nyama zimaika malamulo okhuza kutola zithunzi pa chifukwa chofuna phindu.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Nyama zakuthengo zitha kukhala zamanyazi komanso zolusa. Komwe zimatha kukhala kozizira, kotentha kapenanso osati kwabwino.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Dziko lapansi lili ndi zilankhulo zoposa zikwi zisanu, ndipo zoposa makumi awiri zili ndi olankhula mamiliyoni 50 kapena kuposela apo.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Mawu olembedwa amakhala osavuta kuwamvetsetsa kusiyana ndi mawu oyankhulidwa, nawonso. Izi ndizowona makamaka pama keyala, amene amakhala ovuta kuwatchula momveka bwino.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Mayiko ambiri amalankhula bwino Chingerezi kwathunthu, ngakhale kwambiri umayembekezera kuti amadziwa mochepa makamaka pakati pa achinyamata.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Tangoganizani, ngati mukufuna munthu waku Mancun, waku Boston, waku Jamaica komaso waku Sydney atakhala kuzungulira tebulo kudya mgonero pamalo odyera ku Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Amasangalatsana wina ndi m'zake ndi nkhani zochokera maloawo obadwira, zomwe zimayankhulidwa m'mawu awo omveka bwino komanso gulu la kudelalo.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kugula chakudya mumasitolo akuluakulu ndi njira yopezera chakudya yotsika mtengo kwambiri. Pamene palibe kuthekera kophika, chisankho chimakhala ku zakudya zophika kale.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Masitolo akuluakulu ochulukirachulukira akumakhala ndi gawo logulitsa zakudya zokonza kale. Ena akumapereka mpaka microwave kapena njira zina zotenthesera zakudya.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: M'mayiko ena kapena mu mitundu ina yamasitolo mumakhala malo odyera pompo, nthawi zambiri malowa sakhala okhazikika koma mitengo yake imakhala yomvelera.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Pangani ndikunyamula zikalata za inshuransi yanu ndipo mukhaleso ndizolumikizirana ndi kampani ya inshuransi yanu.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Akuyenela kuonetsa keyala ya imelo ya inshuransi ndi nambala zao zama telefoni ogwira ngakhale kunja kuti alandile chilolezo ndi uphungu komanso chithandizo.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Muchilankhulo chanu mukuyenera kukhala ndi kope ina komanso pa intaneti (muzitumizire nokha imelo ya uthenga wake, kapena kusungidwa mu “cloud”).
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Mukamayenda ndi laputopu kapena kompuyuta yam'manja yotchedwa tablet, muzisunga zina mu memory card kapena disc (zokuti mutha kuzipeza wopanda intaneti).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Apatseniso chikalata cha inshuransi/ zolumikizirana anzanu omwe mukuyenda nawo komaso abale ndi abwenzi omwe ali kumudzi ofuna kuthandiza.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Moose (amadziwikanso ndi dzina la elk) sinyama yoopsya koma imadziteteza yokha ngati iopsezedwa.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Pamene anthu amayitenga ngati Mphalapala ndi nyama yosaopsa, amatha kuyiyandikira kwambiri kumene kuli kuziyika pa chiopsezo.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Kumamwa zakumwa zoledzeletsa moyenelera. Mowa umakhudza anthu mosiyana ndipo kudziwa mulingo wanu ndikofunikira kwambiri.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Mavuto amene atha kubwela chifukwa cha uchidakwa akuphatikizila kuonongeka kwa chiwindi, khungu komanso imfa. Vutoli limakula pamene munthu akumwa mowa wopangidwa mosaloledwa.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Zakumwa zoledzeletsa zopanda chilolezo zimatha kukhala ndi zoyipa zambiri kuphatikizapo methanol, amene amatha kupangitsa khungu kapena kufa pamene wamwedwa wamulingo wochepa.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Mandala amakhala otsika ntengo maiko ena makamaka kumaiko okwela kumene ogwira ntchito amalandila ndalama zochepa.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: pangani ganizo loti akakuyezeni maso anu muli kunyumba, makamaka pamene ngati insuransi ikukhuzaso zamaso, ndikubweretsa mankhwala omwe anakulemberani ndikuti zikasungidwe bwino lomwe penapake.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Maferemu apamwamba amayina otchuka amene akupezeka m'malo amenewa atha kukhala ndi mavuto awiri; ena atha kukhala ongofanana koma sienieni, ndipo amene adachokera kunja atha kukhala odula kusiyana ndiwomwe sakuchokera kunja.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Khofi ndi chinthu chimodzi chogulitsidwa kwambiri padziko lonse ndipo mutha kupeza mitundu yambiri kwanuko.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Choncho, pali njira zapaderadera zambiri zomwera khofi padziko lonse zapansi zomwe muyenera kudzidziwa.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Kudutsa m'malo othamanga madzi (kapena: kudumphira m'madzi othamanga kwambiri odutsa m'mapiri) ndi ngati kupita pansi pa malo ozama, omwe akhoza kukhala owuma kapena odzadza madzi.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Kuyenda malo otsika zedi zimaphatikiza zinthu kuchokera kusamba, kukwera ndi kudumpha-- koma zimafunikira maphunziro ocheperako kapena munthu wazitho kuti muyambepo (poyelekeza ndi kukwera miyala, kusambira m'madzi kapena kutsetseleka m'mapiri, mwachitsanzo).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Kuyenda wapansi ndi ntchito ya panja yomwe imakhuza kuyenda m'malo azachilengedwe, nthawi zambiri pogwiritsa tinjira toyenderamo.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Kuyenda masana kumakhala kwa ulendo wochepa wosakwana mayilosi mpaka mitunda italiitali yomwe itha kuyendedwa pa tsiku limodzi.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Kuyenda kwatsiku limodzi mu njila yosavuta kumafuna kukonzekela pang'ono, komanso ndikofunika, ndipo munthu aliyese wankhongono angathe kukwanitsa.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Mabanja omwe ali ndi ana achichepere atha kufuna kukonzekera kwambiri, koma kutuluka kunja patsikulo nkotheka mosavutikira ngakhale ndi makanda omwe ndi ana osayamba sukulu.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Pali ma bungwe oposa ma zana awiri pa dziko lonse amene amakonza za maulendo. Ambiri mwa iwo ndi oima paokha.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Mlowa malo wa Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours amalumikizana ndi magulu okonza ma ulendo m'ma Kontinenti anayi.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Poti pali ubale ku Barcelona ndi Running Tours Barcelona komanso ku Copenhagen ndi Running Copenhagen, inapanga ubale ndi Runing Tours Prague yaku Prague.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Pamakhala zinthu zochuluka zimene muyenera kuzilingalira musananyamuke mwinaso pamene mukupita malo ena.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Pamene muli pa ulendo, dziwani kuti zinthu zina sizifanana ngati za “kwanu”. Ulemu, malamulo, chakudya, magalimoto, malo ogona, milingo, chilankhulo ndi zinaso sizingafanane ndi kumene mumakhala.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Ichi ndi chomwe mukuyenera kukumbukira nthawi zonse, kupewa kukhumudwitsidwa kapena kusokoneza njira zomwe muchitira zinthu.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Amkhala pakati amaulendo akhala alipo kuyambira mzaka zamzana khumi ndi chisanu mchinayi. Mkhala pakati waulendo ndiwofunika makamaka pamene ulendo wanu ndiwofuna kuwona zosiyana ndizimene mudakomana nawo wam'mbuyomu pazachilengedwe, chikhalidwe, chilankhulo kapena mayiko omwe chuma chawo chili chotsika.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Ngakhale mabungwe ochuluka amafunitsitsa kusungitsa malo pafupipafupi, amkhalapakati ambiri anazama pamitundu ina yamaulendo, gawo la zachuma kapena komwe anthu angapite.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Kutha kukhala koyenera kugwiritsa ntchito mkhalapakati amene kawirikawiri amapeza maulendo ofanana ngati anu.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Onanai maulendo amene mkhalapakati akulimbikitsa, kaya pa tsamba la intaneti kapena pawindo la shopu.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Ngati mungafune kuona dziko losadula, zofunikira, makhalidwe ndi zoletsa, pali njira zina zomwe mungapange.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Kwenikweni zimakhala m'magawo awiri: Kugwira ntchito pamene uli koyendako kapena muyese kuchepesa zogulagula. Nkhaniyi ikukamba kwambiri njira yochepetsa zogulagula.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Kwa iwo omwe akufuna kutaya kutakasuka, nthawi, komaso kulosera zam'mene mungachepetsere zogula zanu mpaka pa ziro, wonani ndondomeko ya ndalama yosachepera ya ulendo.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Malangizo akuganizila kuti anthu apaulendo samaba, kupita malo aeni opanda chilolezo kapena kutenga mbali pa misika yosaloledwa, kupemphetsa kapenanso kubela anthu ena.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Malo owona za anthu olowa ndikutuluka ndiwo oyambilira kuyimapo mukatsika ndege, sitima kapena galimoto ina.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Oyendela mmasitima ena apantunda owoloka amalire a maiko amayendela sitima ikuyenda ndiye muyenela kukhala ndi makalata oyenela a ulendo pokwela.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Masitima ogona usiku, ziphaso zoyendera zimatha kutengedwa ndi wochititsa kuti musalore kuti kugona kwanu kusokonezedwe.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Kulembetsa ndi china chofunikira zedi popanga chilolezo chokhalira dera lina, m'maiko ena umayenera kulembetsa ndi akulu aboma.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Izi zikhoza kufuna kulemba pa fomu yapolisi yakudera komweko kapena kupita ku ma ofesi owona anthu olowa ndi kutuluka mdziko.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: M'mayiko ambiri omwe ali ndi lamulo ngati ili, malo ogonamo amdzikomo amapanga kalembera (muyenera kufusa ndithu).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Mu nthawi zambiri zina, omwe amene amakhala kunja kwa malo omwe kuli alendo ayenera kulembetsa. Choncho , izi zimapangitsa kuti lamuloli lisaoneke bwino kwambiri, choncho fufuziranitu.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Ukadaulo ojambula nyumba umagona pakajambulidwe ndi kamangidwe ka nyumba. Kajambulidwe ka nyumba pamalo pakokha kumakhala kochititsa chidwi kwa alendo.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Manyumba ambiri ndiokongola kwambiri m'maonekedwe ake komanso maonekedwe ochokera nyumba yayitali kapena pazenera lokhala mwaluso akhoza kukhala okongola kuwona.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Ntchito zomangamanga zimakhudzana ndi magawo ena kwambiri kuphatikizirapo mapulani a m'matauni, zomangamanga zaluso, zokongoletsa, kapangidwe kazamkati ndi maonekedwe.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Popeza ma pueblo ambiri amakhala ngati kutali, simungapeze moyo wazochitika wausiku musanapite ku Albuquerque kapena Santa Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Choncho, pafupifupi makasino onse ali pamndandanda pamwambapo amakhala ndizakumwa, ndipo ambiri ayiwo amabweretsa zisangalaro zotchuka (makamaka zikuluzikulu zongulira madera a Albuquerque ndi Santa Fe).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Chenjezo: malo omwerako mowa opezeka mtimizinda ting'onoting'ono siabwino kuchezako nthawi zonse kwa alendo omwe akuchokera kunja.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Pachifukwa chimodzi, kumpoto kwa New Mexico kuli mavuto akulu oyendetsa galimoto utamwa mowa, ndipo kuchuluka kwa woyendetsa magalimoto ataledzerawa ndi kwakukulu pafupi ndi m'matauni ang'onoang'ono omwerako mowa.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Zithunzi zopanda pake kapena zojambula ndimanja pa khoma zimatchedwa graffiti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Ngakhale zili kutali ndi zochitika masiku ano anthu ambiri amaona kuti ndiyofanana ndi magulu achinyamata owononga katundu wa dziko ndi waeni pogwilitsa ntchito utoto.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Choncho, masiku ano kuli ojambula ovomelezeka, zochitika za zojambula ndiponso “pamakoma ovomelezeka”. Zojambula zamtunduwu nthawi zambiri zimafanana ndi maluso zambiri kusiyana ndi ma tag osavomelezeka.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Kuponya Boomerang ndi luso lomwe alendo ambiri amafuna ataphunzira.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Ngati mukufuna kudziwa kuponya Chida chomwe chimabweleranso, muyenera kuwonetsetsa kuti muli ndi chinanso chobwelera.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Ma boomerang ambiri omwe alipo ku Australia kwenikweni ndi osabwerera m'mbuyo. Ndikwabwino kwa omwe ayamba kumene asazitengere kwambiri.
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Chakudya cha chi Hangi chimaphikidwa mudzenje lotentha pansi pa nthaka.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Dzenjelo limatentha kamba ka miyala yotentha imene imachokera kumoto, nthawi zima m'malo ena kutentha kwa mphamvu ya chilengedwe kumachititsa kuti madera ena apansi akhale wotentha mwachilengedwe.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Chida cha Hangi kawirikawiri chimagwiritsidwa ntchito pophika chakudya chowotcha chamadzulo.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Malo ambiri ku Rotorua amakhala ndi mphamvu ya miyala ya hangi, pamene hangi angathe kupezeka ku Christchurch, Wellington ndi kwina konse.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail ili ndi magawo awiri mu masitima anjanje omwe amakwera oyenda ndikuzungulira mu Cape Town: MetroPlus (imene imatchedwanso Kalasi Yoyamba) ndi Metro (yotchedwa Kalasi Yachitatu).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus ndiyotakasuka komanso simudzadza kwambiri koma mitengo yao ndiyokwelelapo ngakhale ndiyotsika kuposa mametro tikiti ambiri ku Ulaya.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Sitima iliyonse ili ndi makochi a MetroPlus ndi Metro; ma MetroPlus amakhala chifupi ndi mzinda wa Cape Town.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Kunyamulira katundu ena- Musayese dala kusiya chikwama chanu pomwe simukutha kuchiona, makamaka pamene mukudutsa malire adziko lina.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Mutha kugwiritsidwa ntchito kunyamula mankhwala ozunguza bongo musakudziwa, zimenezi zizakupezetsani mavuto ochuluka.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Izi zikuphatikizirapo kudikilira pamzere, pamene agalu onukhiza amatha kuwagwiritsa ntchito nthawi iliyonse opanda chenjezo.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Mayiko ena ali ndi zilango zokhaulitsa ngakhale kwa omwe alakwitsa koyamba, anthu amawatumiza kundende kwa zaka 10.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Zikwama zokhala zokha zimakhala pa chiopsezo chobedwa ndiponso zimapatsa chidwi akuluakulu poganiza kuti mutha kukhala muli bomba.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Kunyumba , chifukwa choyandikirana ndi magelemusi , chikhulupiro chilipo kuti uli ndichitetezo chokwera mthupi.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Madera ena adziko lapansi, kumene nyama za bacteria zili zatsopano kwa inu, mutha kukhala pamavuto wochuluka.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Komanso, mu nyengo yotentha tizilombo ta bakiteriya timakula msanga ndi kupulumuka kwa nthawi yayitali kunja kwa thupi.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Ndiye mlili wa Dehli Belly , tembelero la Farao, kubwenzela kwa Montezum ndi anzao ena.
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Ndi m'mene zimachitikiraso ndi mavuto akapumidwe kumalo wozizira, kumalo wotentha mavuto am'mimba amachulukirapo choncho nthawi zambiri amasautsa ngakhale siwowopsa.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Ngati mupita ku dziko lotukuka kumene koyamba - kapena malo ena a chilendo - musanyalanyaza kuti patha kukhala kusanvetsesana chifukwa chosiyana chikhalidwe.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Oyenda ambiri okhazikika, otha kuchita bwino agonjetsedwa ndi zatsopano zapaulendo wapadziko lonse lapansi, komwe kusintha pang'ono kwazikhalidwe zambiri kumatha kuwonjezeka mwachangu.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Makamaka m'masiku anu oyamba, lingalirani za kukhala malo ogona azikhalidwe zaku maiko akumadzulo komanso malo abwino, chakudya, ndi ntchito zina kuti muzolowere.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Osagona pa matilesi pansi mdera lomwe zinyama zake simukuzidziwa.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Pamene mukufuna kokamanga msasa, tengani kama komanso machira kuti musakalumidwe ndi njoka, zinkhanira ndiponso zina zotero.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Dzadzani nyumba yanu ndi khofi wamtengo wapatali nthawi ya m'mawa ndi tiyi wochotsa nkhawa wa chamomile nthawi ya usiku.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Pamene uli pa tchuthi mdziko mwako mom'mo, umakhala ndi nthawi yambiri yosangalala komaso umakhalaso ndi nthawi yoti nkufulula kenakake kapaderadera.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Ngati mukumva kuti mufuna kudziwa zambiri, mwayi ndiwomwewu wopanga juwisi kapena pangani juwisi pogwiritsa ntchito makina otchedwa blender.
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Mwina mutha kupeza chakumwa chosavuta kukonza chomwe mungagwiritse ntchito pa chakudya chanu cham'mawa pamene mukubwelera ku ntchito zanu zamasiku onse.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Ngati ukukhala mu mzinda umene uli ndi miyambo yosiyanasiyana ya kamwedwe, pita kumalo omwela mowa amene ali mudela lomwe sufikafikako.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Kwa amene sadziwa mawu omwe amagwiritsa ntchito ndi azachipatala, mawu oti kupatsirana matenda pakati pa anthu podzera ku tizirombo kapena ndi anthu okhaokha ndi mawu woti kupatsirana matenda pakati pa anthu okhaokha basi ali ndi matanthauzo awoawo.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Matenda opatsirana ndi amene amayamba chifukwa cha tizilombo, ngati ma vayilasi, bakiteliya, fangasi kapena ena ma parazayiti.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Matenda opatsilana ndi matenda amene amapatsilana mosavuta pamene mwayandikana ndi odwalayo.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Maboma ambiri amafuna alendo olowa, kapena eni nthaka ochoka, maiko awo kulandira katemera wamatenda osiyanasiyana.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Malamulo amatengera kawirikawiri mayiko omwe muNthu wapita kapena komwe akufuna apite.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Chimodzi mwazinthu zamphamvu ku Charlotte, ku North Carolina ndikuchuluka kwa zinthu zapamwamba zoyenera mabanja.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Anthu okhala madela ena nthawi zambiri amatchula ma ubale am'mabanja ngati chifukwa choyambilira chopitila kumeneko ndipo alendo nthawi zambiri amapeza kuti mzinda suvuta kusangalala ndi ana.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Zaka 20 zapitazo, kupezeka kwambiri kwa zoti musankhe zimene zili zokomera ana ku Uptown Charlotte zakula kwambiri.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Magalimoto amatola samagwiritsidwa ntchito ndi mabanja ku Charlotte, ngakhale akhoza kukhala othandiza munjira zina.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Pali kuonjezera malipilidwe anthu awili akakhala pa mpando, choncho izi zimakhala zokwelerapo mtengo.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Kwa Antarctica ndikozizira mopitilira muyezo pa dziko lonse lapansi, komanso lidazungulira South Pole.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Maulendo azokopa alendo ndiwokwera mtengo, amafuna kukhala olimba mthupi, amatha kuchitika mnyengo yachilimwe kuyambira Novembala-Febuluwale, ndipo amakhala kumalo owerengeka monga ku Chisumbu, Zilumba komaso kunyanja ya Ross.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Anthu ogwira ntchito zikwi amakhala kuno nthawi yotentha mu manyumba makumi anayi, asanu ndi atatu makamaka malo amenewo; anthu ochepa okha amakhala kuno nyengo yozizira.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Nkatikati mwa Antartica muli phiri lokutidwa ndi madzi owuma kwa ntunda wautali ngati makilomita 2 mpaka 3.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Akadaulo oyenda m'mwamba pena amayenda pamtunda, basi kulizungulira phiri kapena kufika kunsonga kwenikweni kwa dziko koma ndikotakasuka.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: South Pole Traverse (kapena Msewu waukulu) ndi msewu wotalika makilomita 1600 kuchokera ku McMurdo Station ku Ross Sea kupita kumapeto kwa Pole.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Ndimadzi ouma ofewa koma othinana omwe ali ndi ming'alu ikuluikulu yomwe ili ndizizindikiro. Kutha kuyendedwa ndi ma thirakitale apadera, magalimoto oyenda pamadzi owuma atanyamula mafuta ndi akatundu ena.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Zimenezi sizotakasuka moyenera choncho njirayo ndiyokhota kwambiri kuti ikazungulire Mapiri a Transantarctic kuti ikafike pa mwamba pa chigwa.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Zimene zimayambisa ngozi zambiri munthawi yozizira ndi misewu yotelela, njira zoyendamo (moyenda anthu apasi) komaso masitepe.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Mosachepera, mukhale ndi nsapato zomwe zazidendene zabwino. Nsapato za nthawi yotentha nthawi zambiri zimakhala zotelera pa madzi wowuma ofewa, ngakhaleso nsapato za nthawi yozizira zimakhala zosakwanira.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Kachitidwe kake kayenera kakhale kokwanira, 5mm (1/5 inchi) mwinanso kuposera apo, komanso zinthuzo ndizofewa malingana ndi kunthawi yozizira.
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Nsapato zitalizitali zina zimakhala toyimilira tambiri tozaza pansi pansapato ponse ndipo palinso zida zina zokhala ndi toyimilirati timene timagwiritsidwa ntchito ngati pansi pakutelera, zoyenera ku nsapato zambiri ndi nsapato zitalizitali, zidendene kapena zidendene ndichapansi cha nsapato.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Zidendene ndi zofunika kuti zikhale zotsika komanso zotambalala. Mchenga, miyala kapena mchere (calcium chloride) kawirikawiri zimakhala zamwazidwa m'misewu mwinanso mnjira pothandiza kuchepesa kutelera.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Ma avalanche siachilendo; mapiri otsetseleka amatha kuchepa, ndipo kuchuluka kwake kumatsika ngati ma avalanche.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Vuto ndilakuti Chipale chimamata, choncho chimafunika kusungunura, ndipo chipale china chimatheka kuyambitsa zinthu zinanso zambiri.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Nthawi zina chochititsa choyambirira chimakhala ndi dzuwa kutenthetsa madzi owuma, nthawi zina kugwa madzi owuma owundana wofewa ochulukirapo, nthawi zina zochitika zina za chilengedwe, kawirikawiri munthu.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Nkuntho ndi mpweya umene umazungulira umene umakhala wochepa mphanvu ndipo umayamwa mpweya ozungulira kuukokela mkati komanso mokweza.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Zimapanga mphepo ya mkuntho (nthawi zambiri mamayilosi 100-200 / ola) ndipo amatha kuwulutsa zinthu zolemera kupita mumlengalenga, ndikuzinyamula komwe tornado akupita.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Zimayamba ngati ma fanelo kutsika kumitambo ndipo nkukhala “kamvuluvulu” akafika pansi.
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Anthu omwe ali ndi VPN (Virtual Private Network) ma netiweki achinsinsi ndi njira yabwino yopewa kuthana ndi ndale komanso IP geofiltering.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Ndiakadaulo pa nkhani ya katumizidwe ka mauthenga pa intaneti pazifukwa zingapo: Amatumiza mauthenga apa intaneti munjira zambiri, osati http yokha.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Nthawi zambiri amapereka mphamvu yothamanga yambiri ndiposo ntchito yapamwamba. Zinthu zimatumizidwa mwachinsisi zoti simungathe kuziziwa ndipo zimapangisa kuti zikhale zovuta kwa akazitape.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Makampani wofalitsa nkhani ndichizolowezi chawo kunama pa cholinga chake, ponena kuti “akuteteza chinsinsi”.
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Zoona zake, ma code amchigawo alibe zovuta pakukopera mosaloledwa; kukopa kwazonse mu disk ikasewera bwinobwino pachida chilichonse pamene disk yeniyeniyo itha kusewera.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Cholinga chenicheni ndichopereka mphamvu kumakampani zoti azitha kuwongolera misika yawo; zonsezi ndinkhani ya ndalama basi.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Kamba kakuti mafoni amayendetsedwa pa intaneti, simukuyenera kugwiritsa ntchio kampani ya mafoni yokhala kumene muli kapena mukupita.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Sikuliso kofunikira kuti mupeze nambala yakudera komwe mukukhala; mutha kupeza malumikizidwe a intaneti pozera satellite ku tchire la Nkhuku, Alaska ndipo sankhani nambala yomwe ikukuwuzani kuti muli ku Arizona.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Kawirikawiri mukufunika kuti mugule nambala yogwira dziko lonse mwapadera imene sikana mafoni a PSTN akakuyimbirani. Kumene nambala ikuchokera kumachititsa kusiyana ndi kumene anthu akuyimbira.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Mapulogamu omwe amamasulira nthawi yomweyo- ali ndi kuthekera komasulira magawo onse a zolemba kuchokera ku chilankhulo china kupita ku china.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Mwazina zomwe zili mugulu ili zitha kutanthauzira zolembedwa muzilankhulo zakunja malingana ndi zizindikiro kapena zinthu zenizeni zina zomwe zaonetsedwa pamene ogwiritsa ntchito akuloza foni yake yam'manja ku zinthuzi.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Makina omasulira asintha bwino kwambiri, ndipo panopa kawirkawiri amapereka zambiri zomasulira molondola (osati zopanda pake kwenikweni), koma kumafunika kusamala ndithu, chifukwa akhoza kukhala kuti adalakwisa zonse.
